Devon (Sales): Handoff: Novus Health signed SOW for Private (VPC). Go-live target 2024-05-10. Primary: Raj Patel (raj@novushealth.com). Requirements: Okta SSO, HIPAA controls, burst ~500 concurrent requests, audit logs to Splunk. PO: PO-99321. Legal: emily+contracts@novushealth.com.

Anya (CSM): Thanks — can you confirm support cadence and training owners? I'll schedule kickoff.

Devon (Sales): Weekly for first 4 weeks then biweekly. No special discounts. Exec sponsor supportive but adoption by data team is uncertain -> renewal risk = medium.

Sam (Support Eng): I'll open ENG ticket for SSO/VPC work. Need SAML metadata + ACS URL + VPC CIDRs. ETA for SSO prototype: 5 business days.

Lydia (Solutions): Recommend 2-week enablement sprint: week1 infra + SSO, week2 testing + runbook. I'll draft runbook and eval prompts. Success metrics: 20k tokens/day, median latency <200ms, 3 playbooks validated.

Anya (CSM): Action items: Anya -> 4-week onboarding plan (share by 2024-04-26). Sam -> ENG ticket + collect metadata (5bd). Lydia -> runbook + prompts (share by 2024-04-24). Devon -> intro email to Raj/legal (ASAP).

Devon (Sales): Intro sent. Raj will provide SAML XML and confirmed cert rotation every 90 days. He also requested 7-year audit log retention.

Sam (Support Eng): Got it. ENG ticket created. I'll follow up on VPC peering details.

Anya (CSM): Kickoff scheduled 2024-04-29. I'll run a short enablement feedback survey after kickoff. Tag me for blockers. :thumbsup:
